summary: The compact one-storey gabled silhouette is charming and recognizable, but the principal entrance remains unverified and several prominent finishes diverge from the reference.

orientation.summary: SV1 is located southwest of the studio and looks east, placing the +u (NW gable) and -v (SW eave side) toward the camera. The tree heavily obscures the +u face, while the visible -v wall shows a tall window but no clearly identifiable entrance. The model has exactly one door, on +u, so it avoids duplicate portals, but neither SV1 nor the north-up aerial establishes that placement.

issues.problem: Principal-entry placement on +u is unsupported by the supplied located imagery; the relevant face is obscured in SV1.
issues.fix: Keep a single principal door, but obtain clear face-specific evidence before assigning it to +u; otherwise leave orientation unresolved.

issues.problem: The model uses a shingle-pattern roof, while the reference prominently shows a pale silver standing-seam metal roof.
issues.fix: Replace the shingle texture with broad pale metal panels and subtle raised seams, retaining the simple gable and projecting eaves.

issues.problem: Brick-like wall texture and broad paired windows weaken the reference’s restrained brown hut character and tall, narrow window cue.
issues.fix: Use a simpler muted brown siding/shingle treatment and emphasize tall, narrow pale-trimmed windows.
